title: I used AI to make Voltane, a RC car game. Then I turned the whole workflow into a free app, Cartouche, and it's out today.
author: MacXou34
selftext:
Hey [r/aigamedev](https://www.reddit.com/r/aigamedev/),

Two months ago I showed you Voltane here, an RC racing game I made with AI for basically everything: code, 3D, textures, sounds, music. I'm a programmer, I can't model a cube, and I had no budget for artists.

The feedback I received for Voltane was awesome ❤️ and many of you asked me how do I work, what's my workflow.... it's been a lot of trial & error, testing, optimizing, re-testing...

I ended up packing everything learned through the journey & the tools  / workflows I used to ease / fasten the development of the game into an app. It's called **Cartouche**, it's free, and the alpha opens today !

**What the video shows:**

* **The Studio.** You describe your game in plain sentences, and your own Claude or ChatGPT subscription does the work. No credits, no markup. Each message is a version you can go back to. The agent plays the game on PC and phone before telling you it's done.
* **One click to publish.** Your game gets a link anyone can play in the browser.
* **All your games in one place.** Steam, other stores, browser games, the ones you made, with a controller or a mouse.
* **Stream your PC games to your phone, TV...**

**What it isn't:** not a new engine. Games are three.js + Rapier, with a SDK on top that holds everything Voltane taught me (fixed timestep, WebGPU with a WebGL fallback, input for gamepad/touch/gyro, online play, optimisation, 300+ tests). Your game is a plain folder on your PC.

We just launched the alpha today. Jump in !

* Download (Windows + Android): [https://cartouche.gg](https://cartouche.gg/)
* Discord: [https://discord.gg/wxqtSHuAkf](https://discord.gg/wxqtSHuAkf)
* Voltane, to see the kind of game it was born from: [https://playvoltane.com](https://playvoltane.com/)

  
I'd love to hear what breaks for you, and what you make with it. We are deploying features progressively so expect to see things moving fast.
